data.content:
I processed all three Uber Eats deductions. One dispute is sent, one was drafted but you chose to skip it, and one is too weak to dispute until we get a ticket photo.

- **UE-9a31 ($24.30): sent.** Evidence was moderate and the win probability is 65%, up from 55%.
  - The dispute cites the pickup record: the order was ready at 12:28 and picked up at 12:33.
  - The ticket lists the Honey Drizzle, but that only shows it was prepared, not packed. The dispute doesn't cite it as support.
  - The writer's first draft failed the wording check, so it was revised and resubmitted before you approved it.
- **UE-9a47 ($11.80): not sent.** This had the strongest evidence, with an 85% win probability, up from 45%.
  - The ticket lists only a Protein Bowl, not the claimed Fruit Bowl.
  - The pickup was 2 minutes after the order was ready (18:20 to 18:22).
  - You chose to skip it, so I won't retry. That leaves about $10 of expected recovery on the table.
- **UE-9b02 ($33.00): weak, not drafted.** The win probability fell from 55% to 30% because no order ticket is on file, so the claimed Green Smoothie can't be checked.
  - **What I need from you:** a photo of the ticket for order UE-9b02. With it, I can re-run the evidence check.

No past lessons applied. My memory only has DoorDash cases, and recall found no similar Uber Eats cases.

The next deadline is 2026-12-12, 28 days away, and it applies to the remaining open case, UE-9b02. I saved the case notes to `/plan.md`.
